summary: Play clips through a mixer that owns time, and keep that playback from writing physics state or continuing after a pause.
objective: clipAction plays on the intended root; timeScale 0 pauses playback; update advances playback and an explicit seek evaluates a chosen mixer time.
applies_when: A Three.js scene plays AnimationClip data on a character, prop or camera rig.
Pause, seek or blending of authored clips is required.
intent_signals: seek to a pose in the animation
example_prompts: Play a glTF walk clip with AnimationMixer.update in the loop and pause it with timeScale 0.
Seek the mixer to a named pose without stepping a physics world.
negative_signals: Calling mixer.update while a rigid-body solver also writes the same bones.
Calling a clip a simulation because it looks heavy.
not_for: Procedural locomotion, inverse kinematics or contact dynamics.
Claims that mixer time is the physics timestep.

principles: A mixer is a player for clips on a particular root. It advances animation time. It does not compute forces.
One mixer per independently animated object keeps clip time local. Sharing a mixer across unrelated roots hides pause bugs.
timeScale 0 pauses every action on that mixer. That is animation pause, not automatic pausing of a solver or of demand-driven rendering.
implementation: Create a mixer on the animated root. Obtain actions with clipAction and play them explicitly.
Call mixer.update(deltaTime) from the same clock that owns presentation time. Do not also write those nodes from a physics copy unless the clip is stopped.

Use mixer.timeScale=0 to pause. For seeking while paused, save its scale, temporarily set it to 1, call setTime(t), then restore the saved scale: setTime scales its input by mixer.timeScale. For a direct clip-time inspection, select an enabled playing action with unit effective time scale, unpaused state and an intentional loop/weight policy; otherwise describe the result as the configured blend at mixer time.

Reset restores saved action configuration and an explicit initial pose or evaluates the chosen initial clip time with the seek policy; time zero is not necessarily bind pose. On disposal of this single-root mixer, call stopAllAction() then uncacheRoot(root), and separately release exclusively owned asset resources.
observable_checks: After play, only the mixer's root and its bound tracks move; an unrelated object stays put.
Setting timeScale to 0 freezes the clip even if the render loop still runs; restoring 1 continues from the paused mixer time.

Pause at mixer.timeScale=0 and seek with the save/set-1/setTime/restore policy: the requested mixer time is evaluated and subsequent playback remains paused. Compare a selected unit-scale action within its clip duration; blended or differently scaled actions follow their declared configuration.

creative_affordances: Clip choice, easing and additive layers are presentation; they must not be sold as contact.
A scrub bar on mixer.time is a free inspection control.
known_limits: Documented Three.js mixer behaviour; installed-version track names and blending differ by asset.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact has been observed for this record.

claims.statement: AnimationMixer is a player for animations on a particular object; update(deltaTime) advances the global mixer time, usually from the render loop; setting timeScale to 0 pauses all actions controlled by that mixer.
claims.scope: Three.js AnimationMixer API; clip playback is not a physics simulation.

source_refs.locator: Class description as a player for animations on a particular object; update(deltaTime); timeScale 0 pauses actions
